ras_models.name: kEpsilon
ras_models.description: Standard two-equation k-epsilon model. General-purpose turbulence model for fully turbulent flows.

ras_models.name: kOmegaSST
ras_models.description: Shear-Stress Transport k-omega model. Better near-wall behaviour and adverse pressure gradients than k-epsilon.

ras_models.name: SpalartAllmaras
ras_models.description: One-equation Spalart-Allmaras model. Efficient for external aerodynamics and attached boundary layers.

ras_models.name: realizableKE
ras_models.description: Realizable k-epsilon variant. Improved for flows with strong streamline curvature, swirl, and rotation.

ras_models.name: RNGkEpsilon
ras_models.description: RNG k-epsilon. Better for swirling flows and transitional behaviour than standard k-epsilon.

ras_models.name: LamBremhorstKE
ras_models.description: Low-Reynolds-number k-epsilon (Lam-Bremhorst). Resolves near-wall flow without wall functions.

les_models.name: Smagorinsky
les_models.description: Classic Smagorinsky sub-grid scale model for LES.
